title: Moodle
short_description: Open-Source Learning Management System for Online Training, Course Delivery, and Capability Building.
long_description: Moodle is an open-source learning management system that enables nonprofits to design, deliver, and track structured training programmes across staff, volunteers, and communities at scale.

title: Motion
short_description: AI-powered task, calendar, and project management tool for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Motion is an AI-powered smart calendar assistant that helps users manage their time by automatically scheduling tasks, habits, and meetings. It aims to optimize schedules by finding the best times for various activities based on priorities and availability.

title: Nagios
short_description: Open-source IT infrastructure monitoring tool for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Nagios is an open-source monitoring system for tracking the health and performance of servers, networks, and applications. It provides continuous monitoring and alerting for infrastructure components such as servers, switches, databases, and services, helping organisations ensure system reliability and uptime.

title: Napkin AI
short_description: AI-assisted visualisation of ideas and concepts for nonprofits
long_description: Napkin AI is a tool that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations turn text, ideas, or notes into simple visual representations such as diagrams, flows, and structured layouts. It supports teams in organising thinking, explaining concepts, and communicating ideas more clearly.

title: New Relic
short_description: Application monitoring and observability for nonprofits
long_description: New Relic is an observability platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations monitor the performance of their applications, websites, and digital systems. It provides visibility into system health, errors, and usage, enabling teams to identify issues and maintain reliable digital services.

title: Notion
short_description: Collaboration tool for nonprofits and social impact teams
long_description: Notion is a workspace application that combines note-taking, databases, project management, and collaboration on a single platform. It enables organisations to organise information, manage workflows, and collaborate in a flexible environment.

title: Olive Video Editor
short_description: Open-source video editing for nonprofit content creation
long_description: Olive Video Editor is a free, open-source video editing software that enables nonprofits and social purpose organisations to create and edit video content for communication, awareness, and documentation. It provides basic to intermediate editing capabilities without requiring expensive software.

title: OneDrive
short_description: Cloud file storage and sharing platform within Microsoft ecosystem for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: OneDrive is a cloud-based storage service by Microsoft that enables organisations to store, access, and share files across devices. It integrates with Microsoft 365 tools such as Word, Excel, and Teams to support collaboration and document workflows.

title: OpenAI Whisper
short_description: Speech Recognition & Multilingual Transcription Platform
long_description: OpenAI Whisper is an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model designed for multilingual speech transcription and translation. The platform supports speech-to-text workflows across multiple languages and audio formats through transcription capabilities.

title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
short_description: Cloud platform for running applications, managing databases, and supporting enterprise systems.
long_description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a comprehensive suite of cloud services built on Oracle’s globally distributed network. It offers a range of services including compute, storage, networking, database, and developer tools.

title: Paybooks
short_description: Payroll and HR management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Paybooks is a cloud-based payroll and Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage payroll, compliance, attendance, and employee records within a single platform. It is designed to simplify payroll processing and statutory compliance while supporting core HR operations for growing teams.

title: PlayHT
short_description: AI voice generation platform for accessibility, multilingual communication, and content creation
long_description: PlayHT is an AI-powered voice generation platform that enables organisations to convert text into natural-sounding speech. It helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations create audio content, improve accessibility, and deliver information in multiple languages and formats.

title: PostgreSQL
short_description: Scalable Open-Source Database Infrastructure
long_description: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database system used by organisations to manage structured operational data, support transactional applications, and build scalable digital systems across cloud and self-hosted environments.

title: Prezi
short_description: Interactive presentations and visual storytelling for nonprofits
long_description: Prezi is a presentation software that enables nonprofits and social purpose organisations to create dynamic, non-linear presentations. Instead of traditional slide-based formats, it uses a zoomable canvas to present ideas visually, helping teams communicate concepts, programmes, and impact more clearly and engagingly.

title: ProWritingAid
short_description: Digital Editing Tools for SPOs
long_description:
A detailed writing editor that provides in-depth grammar, style, and readability analysis for long-form content.

ProWritingAid is a writing enhancement software that provides comprehensive feedback on grammar, style, readability, and originality. It helps writers improve their prose by offering suggestions for various aspects of writing.

title: RapidPro
short_description: Multi-channel communication and messaging platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: RapidPro is an open-source platform that enables organisations to design and manage interactive communication workflows across SMS, WhatsApp,  and voice.

title: Razorpay
short_description: Donation Collection & Payment Infrastructure for NGOs and SPOs
long_description: Razorpay is an India-based payment and financial operations platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations collect online donations, manage digital payment workflows, handle payouts, and support fundraising operations across websites, campaigns, and mobile-first payment channels.

title: RealBooks
short_description: Cloud-based accounting and financial management software for nonprofits and organisations operating in India
long_description: RealBooks is a cloud-based accounting platform designed for organisations that require structured financial management across multiple programmes, branches, or entities. It supports real-time accounting, GST compliance, inventory tracking, and reporting within a single system, and is hosted on cloud infrastructure.

title: Reclaim.ai
short_description: AI-powered calendar and time management tool for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description:
Reclaim.ai is an AI-powered calendar tool that automatically schedules your tasks, meetings, and routines so you don’t have to plan everything manually.
It works with Google Calendar to adjust your schedule as things change, helping you stay organised and make better use of your time.

title: Redis
short_description: Real-Time Data Infrastructure for High-Performance Applications
long_description: Redis is an in-memory data platform used by organisations to improve application responsiveness, enable real-time data access, and support high-speed operational workloads across cloud and hybrid environments.

title: Redmine
short_description: Structured project and workflow tracking for NGOs managing complex, multi-program operations
long_description: Redmine is an open-source project management and issue tracking platform designed for organisations that need structured control over tasks, workflows, and programme execution across multiple projects. It supports custom workflows, role-based access, and centralised tracking, making it suitable for organisations handling complex operations with limited budgets.

title: Rev AI
short_description: Speech-to-text transcription and audio analysis for nonprofits
long_description: Rev AI is a speech-to-text and audio processing platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations convert audio and video recordings into text. It enables teams to transcribe interviews, meetings, and field recordings, supporting documentation, analysis, and reporting workflows.

title: Rossum
short_description: AI-powered document automation for transactional workflows (invoices, finance, operations)
long_description: Rossum is an AI-powered intelligent document processing platform that automates data extraction from documents like invoices, purchase orders, and receipts. It uses artificial intelligence to accurately capture and process information from various document types.

title: Runway
short_description: AI video generation and editing tools for nonprofits.
long_description: Runway is an AI-powered platform that enables users to generate and edit video content using machine learning models. It supports text-to-video generation, video editing, and visual effects within a browser-based interface.

title: Salesforce
short_description: CRM platform for managing donor, stakeholder, and programme relationships.
long_description: Salesforce is a highly customisable CRM platform used by nonprofits to manage donors, programmes, and workflows at scale. It brings data, teams, and processes into a single system, enabling better coordination and visibility across the organisation.

title: Sarvam AI
short_description: Indian language AI and voice technologies for nonprofits
long_description: Sarvam AI provides AI models and speech technologies designed for Indian languages, helping nonprofits engage beneficiaries in their native languages across text and voice. It enables organisations to automate communication, run multilingual helplines, and simplify data collection in low-literacy or rural contexts. This makes programme delivery more inclusive, scalable, and accessible across diverse communities in India.

title: SendGrid
short_description: Email delivery and communication infrastructure for nonprofits
long_description: SendGrid is a cloud-based email delivery platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations send emails at scale. It supports transactional emails (such as confirmations and alerts) as well as campaign emails, enabling reliable communication with donors, volunteers, and stakeholders.

title: Slack
short_description: Team communication and workflow coordination for nonprofits
long_description: Slack is a team communication platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations organise conversations, share updates, and coordinate work across teams. It provides structured channels, messaging, and integrations, while also supporting basic workflow automation within communication processes.

title: Smartsheet
short_description: Collaborative sheets for nonprofits
long_description: Smartsheet is a work management platform that uses a spreadsheet-like interface to enable collaborative work. It helps teams plan projects, track tasks, and manage resources within a structured system.

title: Social Integrated Platform
short_description: Integrated social media management for nonprofits
long_description: A social integrated platform is a type of tool that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations manage multiple social media channels from a single interface. It enables teams to plan content, schedule posts, monitor engagement, and analyse performance across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X (Twitter).

title: Socioboard
short_description: Social media management and scheduling for nonprofits
long_description: Socioboard is a social media management platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations manage multiple social media accounts, schedule content, and monitor engagement. It provides tools for publishing, analytics, and team collaboration across platforms.

title: Soundraw
short_description: AI-generated music for nonprofit content and media
long_description: Soundraw is an AI-powered music generation tool that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations create background music for videos, campaigns, and digital content. It enables users to generate and customise music tracks based on mood, genre, and duration.

title: Spline
short_description: Interactive 3D design platform for NGOs and SPOs.
long_description: Spline is a web-based design platform that enables users to create interactive 2D and 3D content for websites, campaigns, and digital communication. It brings design, interaction, and collaboration into a single environment.

title: Sprout Social
short_description: Social media management and outreach platform for engagement and analytics.
long_description: Sprout Social helps nonprofits schedule content, manage supporter interactions, and track performance across social media. It enables organisations to engage donors and communities more effectively while using analytics to improve campaigns and demonstrate impact.

title: Squarespace
short_description: All-in-one website builder for nonprofits and grassroots organisations
long_description: Squarespace is a cloud-based website builder that allows organisations to create and manage professional websites without coding. It combines design templates, hosting, content management, and tools for donations and communication in a single platform.

title: Stotio
short_description: AI-powered narrative and content platform for digital transformation
long_description:
Stotio is an AI-powered growth narrative platform designed to help organisations create pitch decks, strategic narratives, and data-driven content.

It enables teams to translate ideas, data, and strategy into clear, structured communication across fundraising, marketing, and leadership contexts.

title: Streak
short_description: Email-native CRM for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Streak is a CRM built directly inside Gmail, enabling nonprofits and social purpose organisations to structure donor communication and fundraising workflows without moving to a separate platform.

title: Substack
short_description: Direct newsletter publishing platform
long_description:
Substack is a publishing platform that enables organisations to write, distribute, and manage newsletters and podcasts directly to subscribers via email and web.

It allows to build a direct communication channel with donors, supporters, and stakeholders without relying on social media platforms.
